gizmo.title: Rārangi taki matatā
gizmo.description: He rārangi pouaka taki. Ka tohu ngā kaipānui i ngā tūemi, ā, ka maharatia tō rātou ahunga whakamua ki tō rātou ake pūrere.

configure.title: Taitara
configure.description: Te ingoa o te rārangi. Ka pānuitia ā-waha hei tapanga mō te rōpū pouaka taki.

configure.title: Ngā tūemi
configure.description: He pouaka taki ia tūemi. Kāore e taea e ngā kaipānui te panoni i ngā tūemi kua tohua, kua monokia rānei.

configure.title: Kua tauhia
configure.description: Whakaaturia he rārangi tau, kaua he rārangi matatā.

configure.title: Tūnga
configure.description: Ka huri i ngā tae kia hāngai ki te stop-note.

developer.title: ID rokiroki
developer.description: He ID ahurei hei mahara i te ahunga whakamua o te kaipānui ki tōna pūrere. Ka waihangatia aunoatia; panonitia anake hei tiri i te ahunga whakamua i waenga i ngā rārangi, hei tīmata hou rānei.
